vulnerabilities.title: VEX assessment for CVE-2019-1010022 in beam_go_sdk

notes.title: CVE-2019-1010022 exploitability assessment
notes.text: Disputed upstream glibc issue in pthread stack guard sizing. The Beam Go SDK harness runs on the Go runtime scheduler (goroutines) and does not rely on glibc pthread guard-page allocation for untrusted native code.

threats.details: Disputed upstream glibc issue in pthread stack guard sizing. The Beam Go SDK harness runs on the Go runtime scheduler (goroutines) and does not rely on glibc pthread guard-page allocation for untrusted native code.

vulnerabilities.title: VEX assessment for CVE-2019-9192 in beam_go_sdk

notes.title: CVE-2019-9192 exploitability assessment
notes.text: CVE-2019-9192 is a disputed stack-consumption issue in the POSIX regex compiler regcomp() in GNU C Library when compiling untrusted regular expressions. The Apache Beam Go SDK boot binary (/opt/apache/beam/boot) uses Go's native RE2 regexp package and does not invoke glibc regcomp().

threats.details: CVE-2019-9192 is a disputed stack-consumption issue in the POSIX regex compiler regcomp() in GNU C Library when compiling untrusted regular expressions. The Apache Beam Go SDK boot binary (/opt/apache/beam/boot) uses Go's native RE2 regexp package and does not invoke glibc regcomp().

notes.text: GNU binutils CLI utilities (objdump, readelf, nm, ld, strip) and libbfd are build-time tools inherited from the base OS image and are never invoked on untrusted ELF inputs by the Beam SDK harness at runtime.

threats.details: GNU binutils CLI utilities (objdump, readelf, nm, ld, strip) and libbfd are build-time tools inherited from the base OS image and are never invoked on untrusted ELF inputs by the Beam SDK harness at runtime.

vulnerabilities.title: VEX assessment for CVE-2026-39817 in beam_go_sdk

notes.title: CVE-2026-39817 exploitability assessment
notes.text: These CVEs affect the build-time cmd/go toolchain when building or fetching untrusted Go modules. The Beam Go SDK runtime container does not ship or execute cmd/go; scanners report these solely from the Go compiler version embedded in /opt/apache/beam/boot build metadata.

threats.details: These CVEs affect the build-time cmd/go toolchain when building or fetching untrusted Go modules. The Beam Go SDK runtime container does not ship or execute cmd/go; scanners report these solely from the Go compiler version embedded in /opt/apache/beam/boot build metadata.
